who_may_bargain.value: Employees of a public employer, except elected officials, board and commission appointees, incarcerated workers, and confidential, supervisory and managerial employees
who_may_bargain.quote: (19) “Public employee” means an employee of a public employer but does not include elected officials, persons appointed to serve on boards or commissions, incarcerated persons working under Article I, section 41, of the Oregon Constitution, or persons who are confidential employees, supervisory employees or managerial employees.

scope_of_bargaining.value: Employment relations: monetary benefits, hours, vacations, sick leave, union access and communication, grievance procedures and other conditions of employment, with listed exclusions and special school-district rules
scope_of_bargaining.quote: (7)(a) “Employment relations” includes, but is not limited to, matters concerning direct or indirect monetary benefits, hours, vacations, sick leave, labor organization access to and communication with represented employees, grievance procedures and other conditions of employment.

impasse_procedure.value: Mediation after 150 days of bargaining, then optional fact-finding and final offers. For strike-permitted units, the employer may implement its final offer and employees may strike after the cooling-off period; strike-prohibited units go to binding interest arbitration.
impasse_procedure.quote: the public employer may implement all or part of its final offer, and the public employees have the right to strike.

agency_fee_status.value: Not collectible from nonconsenting public employees. PECBA still defines a 'payment-in-lieu-of-dues', but Janus v. AFSCME (2018) bars agency fees from nonconsenting public employees.
agency_fee_status.quote: (18) “Payment-in-lieu-of-dues” means an assessment to defray the cost for services by the exclusive representative in negotiations and contract administration of all persons in an appropriate bargaining unit who are not members of the organization serving as exclusive representative of the employees.

dfr_forum.value: Employment Relations Board. Interfering with, restraining or coercing employees, or failing to comply with PECBA, is an unfair labor practice for a labor organization, filed with the ERB.
dfr_forum.quote: it is an unfair labor practice for a public employee or for a labor organization or its designated representative to do any of the following: (a) Interfere with, restrain or coerce any employee in or because of the exercise of any right guaranteed under ORS 243.650 to 243.809.
